ChatStyle.Name: Chat card style
ChatStyle.Hint: How chat messages and roll, attack and item cards look. Foundry default also leaves the message box and its buttons as they were. This only changes your own view.

Sidebar.Name: Restyle sidebar tabs
Sidebar.Hint: Show Combat, Actors, Items, Journal and the other sidebar tabs as dark leather panels, docked or popped out. This only changes your own view.

Controls.Name: Restyle screen controls
Controls.Hint: Show the sidebar tab icons, scene controls, player list, macro bar, scene navigation and token HUD in leather and gold. This only changes your own view.

Popups.Name: Restyle tooltips, menus and dialogs
Popups.Hint: Show tooltips, right-click menus, notifications, dialogs, dnd5e's roll dialogs and Configure Settings in leather and steel. This only changes your own view.
